opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma *1003pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until March 27, 2000, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
